0.0: Angelic Buster, tell me about this ancient Nova aura you possess. How did it come to be? \r\n#L0##bOh, well there was like this... Umm...#l\n#k
0.1: I apologize if it was to be a secret dear. My curiosity as a priestess overwhelmed my understanding as a person.

yes.0: I believe the spirit dwells within that relic you carry. But only the chosen may access its power...
yes.1: Perhaps you are the Nova deity's most beloved child. I always thought you were quite special.
yes.2: I've heard that #p3000000# is quite taken with you, Angelic Buster. Why don't you pay him a visit? Oh, and #bplease send the ancient Nova my blessings#k when it next makes contact.

no.0: If you ever want to talk about it, my ears are yours.

1.0: What was that?! That crazy old lady knows your true identity. What did you say to her?! \r\n#L0##bChill out, dragon breath! #p3000001#'s like my grandma.#l\n#k
1.1: Don't tell ME to chill out! That's a terribly offensive thing to say to a dragon. I'm all fired up now. Hehe, get it?\r\n#L0##bWhy are you so worried about your identity? I'm the one who should be worried.#l\n#k
1.2: Are you kidding? Who cares about you?! Sure, you've got a pretty face and you wear that outfit like it was made for you, but if anybody finds out a centuries old Nova GOD is hanging out with you, we'll never have a peaceful dinner again.

yes.0: So stop... telling everybody with your eyes, or whatever you're doing. Go talk to that #b#p3000000##k creep in #r#m400000000##k. And don't flirt with him!
